runtime.execution: Synchronous CLI/provider stream and bounded reflection loop; separate history-summary thread; fresh shell process per command
runtime.service_boundary: Owns selected repository edits/Git integration and immediate commands; consumes provider via model adapter, no shared computational fabric traced

summary: A specialized editable-file conversation with model edit formats, Git commits/undo, sequential architect/editor models and lint/test reflection. Its compact scope exposes several useful contrasts with a general programmable harness.

inspection.scope: Read run/input/provider/edit/result/reflection flow, concrete edit-block writes, shell/PTY dispatch, history thread/summarizer/fallback, model/mode/command script operations, diagnostics and benchmark test oracle.
inspection.limits: No acquired code executed. Repo-map internals, all edit formats, GUI/watch paths, provider dependency transport and full benchmark evaluator not exhaustively inspected.

actions.name: model edit blocks
actions.input: selected filename plus SEARCH/REPLACE code block
actions.output: written files, partial edit failure/reflection or commit bookkeeping
actions.lifecycle: dry-run/prepare before writes; multiple edits are not a transaction
actions.authority: model edits selected files under coder policy

actions.name: suggested shell script
actions.output: merged stdout/stderr and command exit result shared into chat
actions.lifecycle: explicit-required yes, dedup within batch, fresh sequential shell; no live task handle
actions.authority: model suggestion requires operator approval; --yes declines this prompt

actions.name: /run /test
actions.input: command or supplied callable test hook
actions.output: streamed output; nonzero error report for reflection
actions.lifecycle: synchronously run then optionally append output; no process custody API

actions.name: architect/editor handoff
actions.input: architect text and configured editor model/edit format
actions.output: editor writes/commits and merged cost/commit IDs
actions.lifecycle: sequential editor run with fresh conversation; no live peer mailbox
actions.authority: selected two-model workflow with optional auto_accept_architect

actions.name: /model /editor-model /weak-model
actions.lifecycle: operator input boundary; loaded command script skips transition

actions.name: history summary/restore
actions.input: completed messages, token budget and selected models/Markdown log
actions.output: replacement summary+tail or warning; originals absent from active list
actions.lifecycle: separate thread snapshot/join; failed result can still adopt empty output
actions.authority: host automatic summarizer; no model repair transaction

actions.name: /load /save
actions.input: command file path or output file
actions.output: sequential command outcomes or reconstructed selected file list
actions.lifecycle: load catches/skips SwitchCoder; saved file selection not runtime snapshot

actions.name: benchmark task tests
actions.input: candidate workspace and original test paths/language
actions.output: runner exit-derived outcome and test stdout
actions.lifecycle: original test recopy, 180-second subprocess bound, sequential task attempts
actions.authority: researcher benchmark program; not live model harness promotion

filesystem.detail: Selected repository files are read and model edit blocks dry-run/prepare/apply into actual writes; partial successful edits can precede later failure.

processes.detail: Model shell suggestions require explicit approval; operator run/test supported. Fresh piped/interactive commands stream merged output, no reusable task handle/timeout/process-tree settlement traced.

code_actions.detail: Model-generated shell scripts can run sequentially after explicit yes, with output added to chat. No general nested-tool code-action kernel.

persistent_kernel.detail: persistent_kernel: not established in the inspected synchronous CLI/edit/history/shell surfaces; no universal absence implied.

standing_database.detail: standing_database: not established in the inspected synchronous CLI/edit/history/shell surfaces; no universal absence implied.

workflow_programming.detail: Programmatic Coder run and operator command files compose bounded reflection/edit/test stages. Loaded scripts skip model/mode SwitchCoder rather than redefine active turn.

multi_model.detail: Main/weak/editor roles and sequential architect→editor run are implemented; selecting models is not concurrent dialogue.

live_collaboration.detail: Architect/editor exchange is a sequential fresh editor run, not independently working addressed participants; no busy-target colleague messaging established.

concurrent_work.detail: History summarization runs in a separate thread; main joins before adopting result. Interactive/tool work is synchronous and no model-exposed ongoing process/peer handle traced.

steering_interrupt.detail: KeyboardInterrupt ends a provider reply and records a synthetic interruption message; synchronous input loop waits for run_one, no busy guidance mailbox. Shell path has no explicit descendant stop/join guarantee.

turn_redefinition.detail: Embedding author can supply Coder classes/summarizer/test callables; operator switches compiled Python coder/model modes. No model hot replacement of the governing loop established.

compaction.detail: Background summary replaces done_messages after snapshot equality. Head can be truncated before summary. Source-inferred all-model failure causes caught ValueError with empty summary subsequently adopted; no successful outcome guard.

context_repair.detail: Optional Markdown chat restore and current repository context allow reacquisition, but summary replacement loses original working messages and source transformation lineage not retained there.

original_audit.detail: Formatted optional request/assistant diagnostics and Markdown history/Git edits are useful, but write failure disables logging and original provider envelopes/attempts/transformation IO are not captured comprehensively.

audit_query.detail: Input/chat history can be restored/read as files; selected file list scripts do not reconstruct original provider/program audit. No dedicated model audit query surfaced.

hot_change.detail: Operator changes model/editor/weak model through SwitchCoder; sequential loaded command scripts explicitly skip SwitchCoder. No active-stack code reload or affected-workflow pending generation traced.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Restore selected Markdown chat/files and Git bookkeeping, not executable compile handoff or in-flight program/provider continuity.

remote_services.detail: remote_services: not established in the inspected synchronous CLI/edit/history/shell surfaces; no universal absence implied.

self_improvement.detail: Bounded lint/test reflection is real code repair driven by tool results, not harness autoresearch or an independent promotion experiment.

complaints.detail: complaints: not established in the inspected synchronous CLI/edit/history/shell surfaces; no universal absence implied.

authority.detail: Automatic yes still declines explicit-required model shell prompts. Standing selected-file/read-only policy and edits exist, but this is a concrete friction limit for Arconaut operator intent.

evaluation.detail: Lint/test return errors feed bounded reflection; benchmark restores original test files and checks runner exit. Tests inspect literal summary fallback/output; no complete scientific correctness or harness-quality oracle implied.

time_order.detail: Synchronous request/edit stages have explicit order; retry uses sleep, interrupt debounce and diagnostic timestamps use wall clock; benchmark has subprocess timeout, shell path lacks one.

evidence.claim: Interactive/single-message run initializes edit/result state and repeats reflected errors to bounded max_reflections.
Assembles selected request, retries transient provider exceptions with sleep, handles interrupt and partial output; no live input mailbox in this path.
Applies edits, commits, moves completed conversation, runs lint/shell/test and asks before error reflection.
Edit pipeline dry-run/prepare/apply; malformed/general exceptions report reflected messages, not atomic edit transaction.
Model blocks separate file replacements and shell suggestions; searches other selected files on failed match, writes successful edits before reporting remaining failures.
Fresh subprocess merges stderr/stdout, streams one character at a time then waits; no timeout or process-group cleanup in inspected path.
TTY path transfers user interaction to pexpect, captures output, closes then returns exit status; no standing process handle.
Suggested shell command batches require explicit_yes_required and sequential run_cmd, dedup within batch.
yes=True chooses n for explicit_yes_required prompts; automatic yes does not grant suggested command execution.
Architect output becomes a separate selected editor-model run with cleared chat, then bookkeeping merges; sequential not live peers.
Operator main/editor/weak model changes raise SwitchCoder after constructing model candidate.
Summary worker output starts empty; restore parses selected Markdown history and starts summary.
Worker catches ValueError without publishing a replacement; join assigns summarized_done_messages if source snapshot still matches. Empty default can replace original history on failure.
Summary keeps bounded tail and truncates head to model input budget, can recursively summarize; only user/assistant roles supplied to model; all models failing raises ValueError.
Optional request diagnostic is formatted messages; finally records reconstructed assistant content/function prose, not original provider wire/deltas.
Optional appended formatted LLM log uses wall timestamp; write failure warns and disables future logging.
Operator run/test executes command; output enters chat by explicit choice or nonzero test exit; callable test hook supported.
Loads sequential slash commands, skipping SwitchCoder changes; save reconstructs selected file list only.
Benchmark recopies original tests, invokes language runner with timeout and checks actual return code, appends test output; only task test suite oracle.
Mock summary tests assert literal prefix/result and second-model fallback; no background worker all-model failure/history retention oracle.
Echo test asserts actual exit zero and literal stdout; not cancellation or descendant cleanup.

tests.focus: literal summary shaping and provider fallback
tests.oracle: Mock provider asserts exact summary prefix and second-model fallback; tests do not invoke Coder background worker on all-model failure.
Actual echo must return exact Hello, World! and zero; no cancellation/cleanup oracle.
Inspected literal selected-file sets and empty read-only selection; repository listing mocked, not concurrent shared-writer proof.

strengths: Architect/editor roles and bounded reflections are concrete separate policies.
Benchmark test source restoration improves independence from candidate edits.
limits: Suggested shell command --yes declines explicit-required prompts.
Source-inferred summary failure can discard completed history; not executed.
Formatted optional logs, synchronous commands and chat restoration do not establish audit/refit continuity.
arconaut_questions: Keep general program actions as operations, not ambiguous prose requiring shell approval.
Inject all-summary-provider failure at worker publication and require original history remain selected.
Use independent immutable evaluator material and explicit promotion outcome for autodroit, beyond bounded repair reflections.
